Dear FamLiving Team,

I am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration regarding the complete lack of response from your team.

It has now been months since this issue began, and I have been consistently following up over the past 15 days without receiving any meaningful reply. Despite sharing my bank account details for the refund, I have not received my deposit back. Instead, I continue to receive generic automated responses stating that you are busy or will respond later, which is unacceptable at this stage.

I would also like to remind you that during my visit to Dubai, my booking was cancelled at the very last moment while I was already there. This caused significant inconvenience and unnecessary stress. The way the situation was handled reflects a serious lack of professionalism.

At this point, I need clear and immediate answers:

Why has my refund not been processed yet?
What is the exact reason for the delay?
When can I expect the money to be credited back to my account?
For your reference, I am sharing my complete bank and booking details again:

Booking Reference Number: 953173559949

Beneficiary Name:
PUKHRAJ SINGH TREHAN

Beneficiary Address:
House No. 108, Phase 3A, Mohali, SAS Nagar, Punjab, 160059

Bank Name:
HDFC Bank

Account Number (IBAN):
50100040533149

SWIFT Code:
HDFCINBB

Bank Address:
HDFC Bank, SCO - 56-57, Phase 7, Mohali, SAS Nagar, Punjab, 160062

Currency: INR

I am also attaching all relevant documents again for your reference.

Please treat this matter as urgent and provide a concrete response with a definite timeline for the refund. I expect a prompt and satisfactory resolution without any further delays.
